description: If a finite subset of a partial order has exactly one minimal element, that element is least.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.finite_unique_minimal_isLeast.{u} {α : Type u} [PartialOrder α] {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite) {m : α}
  (hm : Minimal (fun x => x ∈ s) m) (hu : ∀ (x : α), Minimal (fun x => x ∈ s) x → x = m) : IsLeast s m
